title: Getting Started with FIESperu
text: FIESperu streamlines estimation Moderate Severe Severe food insecurity prevalence Peru National Household Survey (ENAHO, conducted INEI) using Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES, Sustainable Development Goal Indicator 2.1.2). Specifically, FIESperu implements official INEI / FAO methodology: Automated microdata download & caching INEI’s srienaho repository (annual surveys 2025 onwards). Modular household harmonization linking Module 2082 (enaho01-{year}-130, FIES) Module 34 (sumaria-{year}-12g) optional housing/NBI ("housing"), household demographic composition ("demographics"), education/disability/insurance ("education_health"), social protection programs ("programs"). Weighted Rasch calibration & global equating FAO FIES global reference scale (fies.global.st), including 32-bit Stata float population weight matching (as_stata_float()). Combined variance estimation combining Taylor-linearized complex-survey sampling error (se_s) Rasch latent measurement error (se_m).
code: library(FIESperu)

what: 2. Preparing Household Microdata and Fitting the Rasch Model
title: Getting Started with FIESperu
text: internet connection, running prepare_fies(years = 2025, include = "") automatically downloads caches required ENAHO 2025 Stata files first use returns clean household-level tibble: offline illustration, use bundled synthetic stratified dataset fies_sample: prepare_fies() returns household-level tibble containing conglome, estrato, wt_hh, wt_pop, pr_mod_sev, can also pass directly survey::svydesign() survey::svyglm() multivariable regression analyses.

title: Guía en Español: Estimación de Inseguridad Alimentaria con FIESperu
text: El paquete FIESperu automatiza la descarga, armonización, validación psicométrica (Modelo de Rasch) y estimación poblacional de la Inseguridad Alimentaria Moderada o Severa y Severa en el Perú partir del Módulo de Inseguridad Alimentaria de la Encuesta Nacional de Hogares (ENAHO) del INEI (desde 2025 en adelante), replicando exactamente la metodología oficial del INEI y la FAO (Indicador ODS 2.1.2).
code: library(FIESperu)

title: Guía en Español: Estimación de Inseguridad Alimentaria con FIESperu
text: partir de 2025, el INEI incorporó de manera permanente el Módulo de Inseguridad Alimentaria (Modulo 2082 en srienaho, archivo enaho01-2025-130, Capítulo 130). Con fies_modules() puedes consultar todos los módulos de la ENAHO que FIESperu puede descargar y cruzar nivel de hogar: "core": Módulo 2082 (8 preguntas FIES) + Módulo 34 (sumaria, pobreza monetaria, gasto e ingreso per cápita, miembros del hogar mieperho) y variables geográficas oficiales (area, department, region_inei separando Lima Metropolitana y Lima Región, y natural_region). "housing": Módulo 01 (agua por red pública, cloro residual seguro, alcantarillado, electricidad, combustible limpio para cocinar, piso de tierra y Necesidades Básicas Insatisfechas nbi_1..nbi_5). "demographics": Módulo 02 agregado hogar (presencia de menores de 5 años has_child_u5, menores de 18, adultos mayores de 60+, y sexo, edad y estado civil del jefe o jefa de hogar). "education_health": Módulos 03 y 04 agregados hogar (nivel educativo y lengua materna indígena o castellano del jefe de hogar, presencia de alguna persona con discapacidad permanente has_disability y seguro de salud SIS/EsSalud). "programs": Módulo 37 (acceso del hogar Vaso de Leche, Comedor Popular, Alimentación Escolar, Cuna Más, Juntos, Pensión 65, Contigo y Bono Gas).
code: fies_modules() #> # A tibble: 7 × 6 #>   block           inei_module module_name_es dta_pattern unit_raw available_from #>   <chr>           <chr>       <chr>          <chr>       <chr>             <int> #> 1 core            2082        Inseguridad A… enaho01-{y… Househo…           2025 #> 2 core            34          Sumarias (Var… sumaria-{y… Househo…           2025 #> 3 housing         01          Caracteristic… enaho01-{y… Househo…           2025 #> 4 demographics    02          Caracteristic… enaho01-{y… Member …           2025 #> 5 education_heal… 03          Educacion      enaho01a-{… Member …           2025 #> 6 education_heal… 04          Salud y Disca… enaho01a-{… Member …           2025 #> 7 programs        37          Programas Soc… enaho01-{y… Househo…           2025

what: 2. Flujo con Microdatos Reales de ENAHO (2025+)
title: Guía en Español: Estimación de Inseguridad Alimentaria con FIESperu
text: Cuando trabajas conectado internet, prepare_fies() descarga por única vez los archivos .dta oficiales del INEI en tu caché local (fies_cache_dir()) y construye la base consolidada de hogares: Si ya descargaste manualmente los archivos .dta o .sav en una carpeta local (por ejemplo, "D:/Inseguridad_Alimentaria_2025"), puedes indicarla con local_dir:
code: # Descarga (si no está en caché) y prepara ENAHO 2025 con todos los módulos: datos_2025 <- prepare_fies(years = 2025, include = "all")  # Replicación exacta del informe técnico oficial del INEI 2025: # Nacional Moderada o Severa: 30.5% | Urbana: 29.3% | Rural: 35.4% | Severa: 3.4% tabla_oficial <- estimate_fies(datos_2025, by = "official") datos_locales <- prepare_fies(   years = 2025,   local_dir = "D:/Inseguridad_Alimentaria_2025",   download = FALSE )

title: Guía en Español: Estimación de Inseguridad Alimentaria con FIESperu

code: base_hogar <- prepare_fies(sample_data = fies_sample, quiet = TRUE)  # Validación psicométrica del modelo de Rasch (severidad, infit, outfit, confiabilidad) val_rasch <- validate_rasch(base_hogar) val_rasch$summary #> # A tibble: 1 × 13 #>    year n_total n_complete n_partial_na n_all_na reliab_fl reliab cor_global #> * <int>   <int>      <int>        <int>    <int>     <dbl>  <dbl>      <dbl> #> 1  2025     400        400            0        0     0.732  0.686      0.998 #> # ℹ 5 more variables: sd_b <dbl>, thresh_mod_sev <dbl>, thresh_sev <dbl>, #> #   max_infit <dbl>, eigenvalue_1 <dbl> val_rasch$items[, c("item_code", "severity_b", "infit", "adj_global_st")] #> # A tibble: 8 × 4 #>   item_code severity_b infit adj_global_st #>   <chr>          <dbl> <dbl>         <dbl> #> 1 WORRIED       -1.49  0.883        -1.58  #> 2 HEALTHY       -1.26  0.985        -1.09  #> 3 FEWFOOD       -1.42  1.07         -1.43  #> 4 SKIPPED        0.548 1.02          0.453 #> 5 ATELESS       -0.324 0.935        -0.402 #> 6 RUNOUT         0.608 1.09          0.653 #> 7 HUNGRY         0.907 1.10          0.973 #> 8 WHLDAY         2.43  0.949         2.42

title: Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) Estimation for Peru
code: library(FIESperu)  # Automatically downloads & caches INEI ENAHO 2025 Stata microdata on first run, # merges Module 2082 (FIES) + Module 34 (Sumaria) + optional sociodemographic blocks, # and calibrates the annual weighted Rasch model: fies_2025 <- prepare_fies(   years = 2025,   include = c("core", "demographics", "education_health", "programs") )  # Official national, urban/rural, natural region, departmental, and Lima breakdowns: # National Mod+Sev: 30.5% | Urban: 29.3% | Rural: 35.4% | National Severe: 3.4% official_tbl <- estimate_fies(fies_2025, by = "official") print(official_tbl)  # Vulnerability profiles (e.g., children < 5 years, disability, social programs): estimate_fies(   fies_2025,   by = c("has_child_u5", "has_disability", "any_food_program"),   indicator = "mod_sev" )  # Psychometric validation & diagnostic plots: val <- validate_rasch(fies_2025) plot_fies(val, type = "equating") plot_fies(official_tbl, type = "prevalence", group = "region_inei")

Implements official 'INEI' weighted Rasch calibration, equating global reference standard, combined sampling plus measurement error estimation complex survey designs following Cafiero, Viviani, Nord (2018) doi:10.1016/j.measurement.2017.10.065 .

what: Convert Numeric Vector to Stata 32-bit Float Precision — as_stata_float
title: Convert Numeric Vector to Stata 32-bit Float Precision — as_stata_float
text: Replicates Stata's default 32-bit single-precision (`float`) rounding numeric vectors preserving `NA_real_` values cleanly. Official INEI routines generate population expansion weight (`facpob = factor07 * mieperho`) using 32-bit float precision; applying `as_stata_float()` ensures exact decimal-level reproducibility official INEI tabulations R.

text: years Integer vector annual survey years (`>= 2025`). title: Estimate Official FIES Food Insecurity Prevalences and Combined Margins of Error — estimate_fies
text: data household-level data frame `fies_tbl` produced [prepare_fies()]. Disaggregation specification: * `NULL` (default): National prevalence survey year. * `"official"`: Generates one call National, Area (`Urban`/`Rural`),   Natural Region (`Coast`/`Highlands`/`Jungle`), 24 Departments + Callao,   official 26-domain regional breakdown (`region_inei`, separating   `Lima Metropolitana` `Lima Region`). * character vector one column names `data` (e.g.,   `c("area", "poverty")` `"has_child_u5"`). indicator Character string indicating FIES threshold(s) estimate: `""` (default), `"mod_sev"` (Moderate Severe), `"sev"` (Severe). conf_level Confidence level margins error intervals. Defaults `0.95`. combine_by Logical; `` vector 2 column names, `TRUE`, also estimates Cartesian interaction variables (e.g., `area x poverty`). Ignored `` `NULL` `"official"`. percent Logical; `TRUE` (default), scales `estimate`, `lower`, `upper`, `moe`, `se_total`, `se_s`, `se_m`, `cv` percentages (`0`–`100`). Set `FALSE` proportions (`0`–`1`).

text: data frame 400 rows 23 columns: year Survey year (`2025`). conglome Primary sampling unit identifier. vivienda Dwelling identifier. hogar Household identifier. ubigeo Six-digit geographic code. dominio Geographic domain (`1`–`8`). estrato Sampling stratum (`1`–`8`, `6`–`8` rural). factor07 Household annual sampling weight. mieperho Number household members. pobreza Monetary poverty code (`1` = Extreme poor, `2` = Non-extreme poor, `3` = Non-poor). pobrezav Vulnerability code (`1`–`4`). gashog2d Annual gross household expenditure (PEN). inghog2d Annual net household income (PEN). p130_1, p130_2, p130_3, p130_4, p130_5, p130_6, p130_7, p130_8 Eight FIES items coded `1` = Yes, `2` = . has_child_u5 Indicator (`0`/`1`) presence children 5 years. has_disability Indicator (`0`/`1`) presence member permanent disability.

text: x Either prevalence table returned [estimate_fies()], household `fies_tbl` returned [prepare_fies()], `"fies_validation"` object returned [validate_rasch()]. type Type plot produce: * `"prevalence"`: Forest/point-interval plot prevalence estimates   confidence intervals (default `x` comes [estimate_fies()]). * `"equating"`: Calibration scatter plot comparing Peru's item severities   rescaled FAO FIES Global Standard (`adj_global_st`). * `"items"`: Item Infit statistics acceptable `[0.7, 1.3]` Rasch   fit band. * `"scree"`: Scree plot residual principal component eigenvalues   assess unidimensionality. indicator `type = "prevalence"`, filters `"Moderate Severe"` (`"mod_sev"`, default) `"Severe"` (`"sev"`). group Optional character string filtering specific `group` column value prevalence plots (e.g., `"region_inei"` `"department"`). year Optional integer year plot (defaults recent year). ... what: Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores — prepare_fies
title: Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores — prepare_fies
text: Reads ENAHO Module 2082 (`enaho01-<year>-130`, Food Insecurity Experience Scale) Module 34 (`sumaria-<year>-12g`), merges optional household member modules (`"housing"`, `"demographics"`, `"education_health"`, `"programs"`), fits official INEI annual weighted Rasch model, equates severities FAO global reference scale, returns clean household-level [tibble::tibble()] ready [estimate_fies()] regression modeling (e.g., [survey::svyglm()]).

title: Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores — prepare_fies
code: prepare_fies(   years = 2025,   include = "core",   cache_dir = fies_cache_dir(),   local_dir = NULL,   sample_data = NULL,   download = TRUE,   quiet = FALSE )

title: Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores — prepare_fies
text: years Integer vector annual survey years (`>= 2025`). Defaults `2025`. include Character vector specifying module blocks download: `"core"` (default: Module 2082 FIES + Module 34 Sumaria), `"housing"` (Module 01), `"demographics"` (Module 02), `"education_health"` (Modules 03 04), `"programs"` (Module 37), `""`. cache_dir Character path local cache directory. Defaults [fies_cache_dir()]. local_dir Optional path local folder containing manually downloaded `.dta` `.sav` ENAHO files (either flat, `"D:/Inseguridad_Alimentaria_2025"`, organized `ModuloXX` subfolders). `NULL` (default), reads `cache_dir`. sample_data Optional pre-loaded list data frame ([fies_sample]) fast offline demonstration testing without reading external files. download Logical; `TRUE` (default) `local_dir` `NULL`, automatically calls [download_fies()] requested module missing `cache_dir`. quiet Logical; `TRUE`, suppresses progress messages. Defaults `FALSE`.

title: Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores — prepare_fies
text: [tibble::tibble()] class `"fies_tbl"` one row per surveyed   household, containing survey design keys (`conglome`, `estrato`, `wt_hh`,   `wt_pop`), official INEI geographies (`area`, `department`, `region_inei`,   `natural_region`), monetary poverty indicators, binary FIES items   (`fies_worried`..`fies_whlday`), raw score (`fies_rs`), household probabilities   moderate--severe (`pr_mod_sev`) severe (`pr_sev`) food insecurity,   requested sociodemographic blocks. Annual Rasch model diagnostics   stored `attr(x, "rasch_models")`.

title: FIESperu 0.1.0
text: Initial release FIESperu. Added fies_modules() download_fies() persistent local caching (fies_cache_dir(), clear_fies_cache()) INEI ENAHO annual microdata (2025 onwards). Added prepare_fies() build regression-ready household datasets integrating Module 130 (FIES) Module 34 (Sumaria) optional household harmonizers Housing/NBI (Module 01), Demographics (Module 02), Education/Health/Disability (Modules 03–04), Social Programs (Module 37). Implemented official INEI Rasch model calibration, global standard equating, as_stata_float() precision matching, combined complex-survey sampling + Rasch measurement error estimation estimate_fies(). Added validate_rasch() plot_fies() psychometric item-fit diagnostics prevalence visualizations, plus synthetic dataset fies_sample bilingual vignettes (English Spanish).
